title: Automatic reminders say on, but the owner cannot see which members will really get them
what: The automatic reminders page shows only how many reminder types are on. It never says, per member or in total, who will get them and who will not (no app, app on iPhone, notifications off on the phone, the member's own switch off, no date of birth). Many members can silently get nothing while the switch reads on.
expected: Beside each reminder: how many members it reaches, and a list of who will not get it and why.
how_often: every time the page is opened
fix_line: Show a reach line per reminder and a who-will-not-get-it list with the reason

title: No record that any automatic reminder ever went out
what: Automatic reminders are set on each member's phone and nothing tells the gym's server when one was shown. The owner has no page to see which member got a birthday wish or a plan-ending reminder, when, or why one did not go.
expected: A list per reminder of who got it and when, and who did not and why, or at least a plain line saying the gym cannot see this.
fix_line: Have the phone report each reminder it set and showed, and list them for the owner

title: Who was already messaged on WhatsApp is remembered on one computer only
what: The WhatsApp send-to-next list remembers who was done in this browser only. If the owner sends half on the laptop and the desk staff opens the same list on another computer or phone, it starts again from the top and members get the same message twice.
expected: Done marks kept with the gym, so every device and every staff member sees the same progress.
how_often: whenever two devices or two people send the same list
fix_line: Keep the who-was-sent marks on the server per gym

title: New-feature dots and news come back on every new device
what: The new-feature dots and the What's new seen mark are kept in one browser. An owner who already looked on the laptop sees the same dots and news again on the phone.
expected: Seen marks kept per person on the server.
fix_line: Keep seen marks per staff login on the server

title: Only the test alert has a record; real alerts and the daily summary have none
what: The owner can send a test alert and see that it showed. For the real alerts and the daily or weekly summary there is no list of what was sent, when, and to which device, so a missed summary goes unseen.
expected: A short history of the last alerts and summaries sent to each device, with failures.
fix_line: Show the last sent alerts per device with their result

title: In the app count includes members who will never see a pop-up
what: Before sending a message the page says how many members are in the app. It counts everyone linked, including members whose phone notifications are off or who use the iPhone app, who only see the message if they open the inbox.
expected: Split the count: will get a pop-up, will only see it in the app.
fix_line: Count members with a saved push address separately

title: Birthday wish depends on a date of birth the page never counts
what: The birthday wish goes only to members whose date of birth is filled in. The reminders page does not say how many members lack it or ask for it. Crispy Curves fill rate not counted (no database query allowed in this step).
expected: Show how many members have no date of birth and a quick way to add it.
fix_line: Show the missing date-of-birth count next to the birthday switch

title: We haven't seen you never goes to a member who has never come in
what: The we-haven't-seen-you reminder counts from the last check-in. A member who joined and never checked in has no last visit, so never gets it, though they are the most likely to drop off.
expected: Count from the plan start when there is no check-in yet.
fix_line: Use the plan start day when no check-in exists

title: Members who renewed or were removed can still get plan-ending reminders
what: Each phone sets up to 60 days of gym reminders ahead and only re-checks when the member opens the app. The background job that runs every 15 minutes does not re-check them. A member who renews at the desk, or whom the owner removes or whose dates the owner changes, keeps getting 'Your plan ends today, renew at the desk' until they open the app. The owner's page promises it is not sent when the member already renewed.
expected: A renewal, removal or date change cancels the old reminders without needing the member to open the app (re-check in the background job, or a push that tells the phone).
how_often: whenever a member renews or leaves and does not open the app before the reminder day
fix_line: Re-check the gym reminders in the background job too

title: iPhone members get no gym reminders or pop-ups, but the owner is told members with the app get them
what: The gym reminders, notice pop-ups and push address all switch off when the phone is not Android. The owner's page says members with the MettleUp app get these on their phone, with no word about iPhone.
expected: Either the iPhone app sets them too, or the owner's page says Android only and counts iPhone members.
fix_line: Say Android only on the owner's page until the iPhone app sets them

title: Gym reminders and pop-ups depend on phone settings nobody can see from the gym
what: Reminders show only if Android notifications are allowed, the Gym reminders channel is on, and the phone maker's battery rules let the 15-minute background check run. None of this is reported back, so neither member nor owner learns that nothing will arrive.
expected: The member app warns when the phone blocks them; the owner sees how many members cannot get pop-ups.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: on a Xiaomi, Oppo or Vivo phone with battery saver on, check that the 9:30 am reminder and the 15-minute pop-up arrive with the app closed for a day
fix_line: Report notification and background-run state with the push address

title: On a crowded day one reminder silently replaces another
what: Only one gym reminder a day is shown. When a birthday falls on the plan's last day, the plan-ends-today reminder is dropped with no trace; the owner's page does not say which one wins.
expected: The owner's page says which reminder wins on a shared day, or the dropped one moves to the next free morning.
fix_line: Name the priority order on the owner's page

title: Watch update ready is shown when the Play Store may have no newer watch build
what: The phone says the watch app has an update whenever the watch's version is lower than the phone's. It never checks that a newer watch build is really on the Play Store for this member. When the watch release lags the phone's, the member is told 'Update ready', taps, finds nothing to update, and is not asked again for this phone version.
expected: Show the watch update only when a newer watch build is really published, or word it as 'check for a watch update'.
how_often: each release where the watch build lags the phone build
fix_line: Compare with the watch version actually published, not the phone's

title: A watch that could not report its version is treated as out of date
what: The watch writes its version for the phone; when that write fails it is only logged. The phone counts a watch with the app but no version as an old build and shows 'Update ready', so an up-to-date watch can be nagged to update.
expected: A missing version reads as 'cannot say' unless the watch is known to be an old build, and the failure is retried and shown in the watch check.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: start the watch app with Bluetooth off, then reconnect and open the phone app; see if it says a watch update is ready on a current watch
fix_line: Treat a missing version as unknown after the ask goes unanswered

title: Watch rest-end buzz can come late with no word to the member
what: When the watch's Alarms and reminders permission is off (off by default on newer Wear OS), the rest-end alarm quietly falls back to a loose alarm that Android may fire late while the screen is off. The member is asked once; after that nothing on the watch says the buzz may be late.
expected: While the permission is off, the rest screen says the buzz may be late and offers to turn it on.
how_often: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: on a Wear OS 5 watch with Alarms and reminders off, start a 90 s rest, let the screen go dark, and time the buzz
fix_line: Show a line on the rest screen while exact alarms are off
